description: Regolith filter for generating JSON files from TypeScript templates (single or multiple) for Minecraft Bedrock Edition, typed against the official Mojang schemas.

include.description: Glob pattern(s) to scan for template .ts files. Paths are relative to temp workspace; 'packs/' prefix is automatically stripped if present.

exclude.description: Glob pattern(s) to exclude from scanning.

pretty.description: Pretty-print generated JSON (four-space indentation). If false, outputs minified JSON.

types.description: Generate .d.ts files from the official Mojang JSON schemas so templates autocomplete. Written into the project (not the temp workspace) so the IDE can read them.

schemaVersion.description: Version of @minecraft/bedrock-schemas to generate from. Accepts a dist-tag ('latest', 'beta') or an exact version such as '1.26.20-beta.21'.

typesDir.description: Where the generated .d.ts files land, relative to the project root. Defaults to '<dataPath>/generated/mc' (usually 'packs/data/generated/mc').

strict.description: Reject properties the schema does not declare. Off by default, because the schemas trail the game by a version or two and would otherwise flag valid fields.

typePrefix.description: Prefix for the generated global type aliases. Empty by default, giving `Block`, `Entity`, `Item`, `Many`. Set it to something like "Mc" if those names clash with your own globals.

maxAgeHours.description: How long the cached npm registry metadata stays fresh before the filter re-checks for a newer schema release. Only consulted when schemaVersion is a dist-tag.
